gloss: same trade; same line of business

definitions.gloss: same trade; same line of business; same industry
definitions.explanation: Being in the same profession, trade, or industry as someone else. Commonly used as a prefix in compounds referring to people or organizations in the same field.

examples.japanese: {同業者|どうぎょうしゃ}と{情報|じょうほう}{交換|こうかん}をする。
examples.english: To exchange information with people in the same business.

examples.japanese: {同業|どうぎょう}{他社|たしゃ}と{比|くら}べて、うちは{価格|かかく}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Compared to other companies in the same industry, our prices are lower.

examples.japanese: {同業|どうぎょう}の{友人|ゆうじん}から{聞|き}いた{話|はなし}では、{業界|ぎょうかい}{全体|ぜんたい}が{厳|きび}しい{状況|じょうきょう}らしい。
examples.english: According to what I heard from a friend in the same line of work, the whole industry seems to be in a tough situation.

notes:
Composed of {同|どう} (same) + {業|ぎょう} (business/trade). Functions primarily as a prefix in compounds, most commonly {同業者|どうぎょうしゃ} (people in the same trade).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同業者|どうぎょうしゃ}: person in the same trade/industry
- {同業|どうぎょう}{他社|たしゃ}: other companies in the same industry
- {同業|どうぎょう}{組合|くみあい}: trade association; guild
- {同業種|どうぎょうしゅ}: same type of business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同僚|どうりょう}: colleague — people at the same workplace, not necessarily same profession
- {競合|きょうごう}: competition; rival — emphasizes the competitive aspect
- {業界|ぎょうかい}: industry — the field itself rather than the shared membership
